uslugi_page.meta_title: Services. Engineering. Construction. Modular Boiler Production & Supply.
uslugi_page.meta_description: Full-cycle engineering. Industrial gas pipelines, manufacturing and delivery of block-modular boiler rooms, stationary boiler construction, natural gas & diesel.
uslugi_page.meta_h1: Energy supply services for industrial facilities. Plant gasification, energy auditing, turnkey design and construction.
uslugi_page.main_pipelines_title: Main Gas Pipelines & Gas Distribution Stations
uslugi_page.main_pipelines_desc: Design engineering of transmission pipelines for high-pressure natural gas transport (5.4–7.5 MPa), pipeline branches, and automated gas distribution stations (GDS).
uslugi_page.gas_dist_title: Gas Distribution Systems & Pressure Reduction Stations
uslugi_page.gas_dist_desc: Design of gas distribution and consumption networks. Our designs consistently obtain statutory approvals from regional gas operators (Mosoblgaz, Mosgaz, etc.) and state expert review boards.
uslugi_page.supervision_desc: Comprehensive engineering oversight during construction, ensuring absolute fidelity to approved project specifications and long-term operational integrity.
uslugi_page.gas_supply_desc: Design and construction of on-site gas pipelines, electrochemical anti-corrosion protection, gas pressure regulating cabinets, metering units, internal piping, safety automation, and burner control loops.
uslugi_page.boilers_desc: LLC Energy Plus specializes in designing industrial steam and hot-water boiler rooms across diverse capacities.
uslugi_page.energy_centers_desc: Construction of small-scale combined heat and power plants (mini-CHP) utilizing highly efficient, environmentally safe cogeneration technologies.
uslugi_page.heat_substations_desc: Detailed working drawings for individual and central heating substations developed in strict compliance with Russian technical construction standards (GOST, ESKD, SPDS).
uslugi_page.gen_designer_desc: Turnkey development of design and estimate documentation, managing the complete regulatory approval lifecycle through final facility commissioning.
uslugi_page.equip_supply_desc: Integrated procurement and supply of thermal power equipment (boilers, burners, gas skids, cogeneration units, automation hardware, power distribution, and SCADA systems).
uslugi_page.construction_desc: Installation and construction is a high-precision engineering process executed by Energy Plus specialists with certified industrial qualifications.
uslugi_page.commissioning_desc: Our specialized commissioning team conducts comprehensive testing, mode tuning, and safety checks to eliminate defects prior to full commercial operation.
uslugi_page.tech_customer_desc: Technical and legal support throughout pre-design and design stages, liaising between investors, subcontractors, and state authorities with rigorous construction oversight.
uslugi_page.thermal_calc_desc: Fuel-to-heat demand calculations required for gas allocation clearances for new industrial builds or retrofitted thermal plants replacing legacy gas equipment.
